profile.headline: Senior Software Test Engineer
profile.summary:
•	11+ years of hands-on experienced in testing web-based, mobile, server-client and cloud applications
•	Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle and Software Testing Methodology
•	Analyze technical documentation for inconsistencies, ambiguities, incomplete requirements 
•	Write test documentation such as test plans, test cases, test matrices, checklists
•	Proficient in functional, GUI, regression, system integration, user acceptance, load, security, browser compatibility, and performance testing
•	Research software defects and make them reproducible
•	Excellent analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and presentation skills with the ability to manage activities in a fast-paced team environment
•	Professional SQA Career minded
•	Strong team player with the ability to work productively in a team as well as individually
•	US citizen

positions.title: Senior Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developing and executing software test plans in order to identify software issues.
•	Devising and implementing test procedures and strategies that adequately assess all software aspects.
•	Investigating and recreating reported defects.
•	Working with other engineers to troubleshoot and resolve coding issues.
•	Tracking and documenting all testing defects and resolutions.
•	Participating in the design and development of test automation and support.
•	Creating Python unit tests for medical devices.
•	Verification and validation of the Android-based mobile application.

positions.title: Senior Test Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Defining Test strategy, planning, creating a code for backend testing, code review. Tracking all activity in Jira.
•	Running automation at different environment QA, Dev, Staging, Production manually, and in Docker.
•	Designing and developing detailed test plans and automation test strategy based on product requirements.
•	Designing, building, and executing automated testing frameworks and automation scripts using Selenium, PyCharm for the frontend as well as backend testing (api, db, ssh).
•	Creating an automation testing tool for frontend and backend components: including UI, API, DB, SSH using, and updating behave (Python) framework.
•	Testing platform architecture, test specifications, test configuration for various tests such as integration testing, system testing, regression testing.
•	CI/CD, Gitlab, BDD, Behave, Virtual Environment.
•	Working with an offshore team, code reviews.

positions.title: Test Automation Lead
positions.description:
•	Designing, building, and executing automated testing frameworks and automation scripts using Selenium with Java.
•	Designing and developing detailed test plans and automation test strategy based on product requirements.
•	Building, customizing, deploying, and managing the environment/ test automation framework.
•	Mentoring, leading, and managing of QA team of 8 manual and automation people.
•	Designing, building and executing automated testing frameworks and automation scripts.
•	Collaborating with Product Owners, Developers and other QA team members as required on acceptance criteria that need to be tested.
•	Experience in working with onshore and offshore resources.

positions.title: Software QA Consultant
positions.description:
•	Developing Test strategy, Test Plan, Test Matrix with test cases and preparing test data, creating DDT automation framework: End to End testing environment from scratch (Eclipse, TestNG). Wrote Test Report.
•	Manually testing of native mobile (Android, iOS) app: Functional testing (Installation Testing, Basic Functionality Testing, GUI Verification, New Requirements Testing, Regression Testing, Error Handling Testing, Longevity Testing) and Non-functional Testing (Performance, Recovery and Stress Testing). 
•	Automation of a Web based and native Windows apps using Java, Selenium, TestNG, Ranorex, svn, Git, Bitbucket, SourceTree, CI/CD. Mobile automation using Appium.
•	Testing Cloud middleware, web servers, web services (REST, SOAP via Ready API), BPEL via Oracle Jdeveloper 11g (SOA).
•	Performance testing using JMeter and Selenium.
•	Testing integration of API via XML to communicate CCTV camera using HTTP or RTP/RTSP protocols to control or set basic camera parameters (e.g. PTZ) and/or capture video streams. 
•	Network analyzing using Wireshark to capture, filter and inspect packets (TCP/IPv4, IPv6, FTP, SFTP, HTTP/HTTPS, IMAP, POP3, SMTP, UDP, RTMS, DNS, DHCP, RTP, RTSP, NTP, SSH, SSL, 802.1x, SNMP).
•	Testing manually 802.1x Network Port Authentication Settings (using RADIUS Server for Wireless or Wired Connections), IPsec, SSL (Self-signed Certificate, Certificate Requests, Server Certificate, Intermediate Certificate, Self CA Certificate).
•	Testing projects in Agile development environment, using Kanban JIRA boards.
•	Working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, based on Development and QA methodologies.
•	Verification of functional spec, writing list of improvements for software.
•	Comfortable taking initiative, self-driven and a team player, leading of interns.

positions.title: Sr. QA Analyst
positions.description:
•	Testing Web UI with the video stream (H.264, MJPEG, MPEG-4 unicast, multicast, broadcast).
•	Creating automated/manual tests for validating software applications using Python, Selenium Web Driver, Lua, Ruby, SVN, Jenkins. Analyzing, summarizing, and report upon component reliability and performance results. 
•	Testing SOAP Web services, using SOAPUI NG Pro.
•	Performing risk analysis of product changes and recommended appropriate test strategies. Collaborated with the product team to define customer equipment configurations in the development of accurate testing scenarios. 
•	Collaborating with the product team to define customer equipment configurations in the development of accurate testing scenarios.
•	Tracking and reported defects discovered during the development lifecycle.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Testing numerous web and mobile applications developed by the company for its domestic and overseas customers – functionality, GUI, localization, usability, regression, release acceptance testing.
•	Writing SQL queries to perform data verification and set up test data.
•	Performance testing using HP LoadRunner.
•	Providing thorough browser-compatibility testing for CMS Drupal application using Apache Tomcat.
•	Testing cloud-based media store application (media-downloading to apps playlist) - functionality, regression, browser and OS compatibility testing: Linux, Windows 7.
•	Creating automated regression test cases using Selenium IDE/RC, Java.
•	Developing test documentation as per work assignment – test plans, test cases, test matrices.
•	Reporting software defects using Mantis bug tracking application.
•	Verifying bugs fixed in new releases.
•	Communicating with developers and QA team members remotely to identify and resolve various issues. Utilized online communication tools on everyday basis.
